title: Nvidia Reportedly Halts AI Chip Shipments To Southeast Asia As U.S. Tightens China Curbs
summary: The reported halt in shipments comes just days after Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia’s CEO following a scandal over his alleged extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
